criteria.text: Every new-chat entry point routes through one profile-first creation flow whose Profile picker is preselected to Secretary before creation.
criteria.test_id: issue-2-c1: every new-chat entry point uses the Secretary-first creation flow

criteria.text: Selecting a profile loads its configured model automatically while profile, model, reasoning, and approval policy remain editable per session.
criteria.test_id: issue-2-c2: profile selection applies the profile model and execution defaults

criteria.text: Session-specific profile, model, reasoning, and approval values persist through MSP-001's PATCH state path and hydrate from the session record on open.
criteria.test_id: issue-2-c3: session edits use the authoritative PATCH and hydration seams

criteria.text: The accessible three-dot sheet contains labeled Profile, Model, Reasoning, and Approval Policy controls plus a per-session scope explanation.
criteria.test_id: issue-2-c4: three-dot configuration sheet labels all session-scoped controls

criteria.text: Profile and Model pickers search human labels plus stable IDs and provider/account metadata.
criteria.test_id: issue-2-c5: profile and model search cover labels IDs and metadata

criteria.text: One session's overrides survive reopening and switching chats without bleeding into another session.
criteria.test_id: issue-2-c6: updating one session cannot mutate another session's execution state

criteria.text: A control that appears session-scoped must never mutate global OpenCode auto-approval.
criteria.test_id: issue-2-c7: session Approval Policy does not write global OpenCode config

criteria.text: VoiceOver focus order, labels, search, and modal dismissal are verified on a signed native build.
criteria.reason: Requires a signed native mobile build and human VoiceOver interaction. The checklist is documented in docs/testing/msp-002-profile-first-sessions-smoke.md; this workstream is prohibited from starting servers or running the device environment.
